title: EscalationDecisions
description: Escalations as Onus Cloud keeps them, with their decisions: the input of `onus provenance --escalations FILE` and `onus ci pr --escalations FILE`. Also read: the API's `{"escalations": [...]}`, a stored row's `status` (for `state`) and `input: {scopes, reason}`, and a view's nested `decision: {by: {id, name}, at, answer}`.

CloudState.description: Where an escalation is in Onus Cloud.

oneOf.description: A blocked report a person answered.

EscalationDecision.description:
One escalation as Onus Cloud keeps it, with its decision: the input of
`onus provenance --escalations FILE` and `onus ci pr --escalations FILE`,
which take a JSON array of these.

answer.description:
Why it was decided so: a denial's reason, or the answer to a blocked
report. The record keeps it as `reason`.

bestGrade.description: The strongest evidence grade (1 is strongest).

clientRequestId.description:
The door's own request id (`.onus/escalations/<id>.json`), which a
submission lists once it is granted.

commit.description: The commit Onus Cloud resolved `ref` to.

decidedBy.description: `system:policy` for an automatic grant, else the person (`user:<id>`).

decidedByName.description: The person's name, shown instead of `decidedBy`.

expiresAt.description:
When a waiting escalation expires: a stored row past it is
`expired`, as Onus Cloud shows it.

pull.description: The pull request number; one for another pull request is left out.

reason.description:
Why the agent asked. Read, but not kept: the record's `reason` is
the decider's, from `answer`.

ref.description:
What the door filed it at: the commit it had pushed, a branch, or
`refs/pull/<n>/head`. With no pull request, it ties the escalation
to the change whose commit, branch or pull request it names.

repository.description: The repository (`owner/repo`); one for another repository is left out.

requestId.description: The request id `onus escalation assess` gave it.

token.description:
The door's inspection of the task token it filed under; never the
token.

Moment.description:
A time: Unix seconds, or an RFC 3339 date in UTC
(`2026-10-12T10:00:00Z`, `Z` or `+00:00`).

TokenInspection.description:
What a door says its task token holds: never the token itself. The door
sends one with each escalation it files in Onus Cloud, and `onus token
inspect` prints one.

expires.description:
Unix seconds. 0, as `onus token inspect` prints it, is none, and so
is a negative or fractional number.
